summary_en: Alex has just moved to Copenhagen and meets his neighbour Anna in the stairwell.

lines.speaker: Anna
lines.da: Hej! Er du vores nye nabo?
lines.en: Hi! Are you our new neighbour?

lines.speaker: Alex
lines.da: Ja, jeg er lige flyttet ind. Jeg hedder Alex.
lines.en: Yes, I have just moved in. My name is Alex.

lines.speaker: Alex
lines.da: Tak. Det er rart at møde dig.
lines.en: Thank you. It is nice to meet you.

lines.speaker: Alex
lines.da: Jeg kommer fra England. Jeg lærer dansk.
lines.en: I come from England. I am learning Danish.

lines.speaker: Alex
lines.da: Tak, men jeg forstår ikke altid det hele.
lines.en: Thank you, but I do not always understand everything.

lines.speaker: Anna
lines.da: Du må gerne bede mig om at tale langsommere.
lines.en: You are welcome to ask me to speak more slowly.

lines.speaker: Alex
lines.da: Nå ja! Det ord kender jeg godt.
lines.en: Oh yes! I know that word.

lines.speaker: Anna
lines.da: Sig til, hvis du har spørgsmål.
lines.en: Let me know if you have questions.

lines.speaker: Alex
lines.en: Thank you very much for your help.

lines.speaker: Anna
lines.da: Det var så lidt. Vi ses!

lines.speaker: Alex
lines.da: Ja, vi ses. Hav en god dag!
lines.en: Yes, see you. Have a good day!
